title: Pretty and Durable
text: Pretty and Durable. Love this gift my 3 year old picked out for me. Looks small but held 10.oz of coffee easily. My son accidentally dropped it and it didn't break and it washed well in the dishwasher. It looks really nice on person and in glad the writing didn't seem like a cheap sticker. My favorite part was the heart inside that you look at with each sip ❤️
